summary: Correct OD-012 after the real resolver exposed a test-only runtime edge.
why: The first real R2 acquisition selected prefixcommons 0.1.12, whose published wheel declares pytest-logging>=2015.11.4,<2016.0.0 as a runtime requirement even though PyPI supplies no wheel and the plugin depends on obsolete test infrastructure. R2 authorizes neither a packaging derivation nor test packages in the compiler runtime. Historical R2 authority remains immutable; a replacement decision must select an exact non-impersonating derived version, transformation boundary, ownership, and acceptance gate.
